metrics.title: 3D Antarctica & Greenland Explorer 🇦🇶
metrics.textSample: Rotate, zoom, and explore Antarctica with interactive layers for bed topography, ice surface/base, velocity, ocean streamlines, subglacial environments, and RISE basal melt drivers. VIEW CONTROLS Region Antarctica Greenland Resolution preset Balanced (10 km grid; ~5.8 MB) HD (4 km grid; ~35.4 MB) Vertical exaggeration 4.0x Ice opacity 0.65 Show bed topography Show ice surface Show ice bottom surface Show refined basins Show ice surface velocity Show ice flowlines Show effective pressure Show subglacial channels Show ocean streamlines Show basal melt Show thermal driving Show sea level (0 m) Wireframe mode Reset Camera Enter Fullscreen BED ELEVATION COLOR -7000 m 0 +3500 m DATA SNAPSHOT Error: Error creating WebGL context. Load failed Enter Fullscreen Mouse: drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, ri
